The Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005 requires all private security agencies to secure a license from their State Controlling Authority. The Home Department of the Government of NCT of Delhi serves as the authority that governs this system in Delhi.
Security agencies need to follow these rules as established by the PSARA license in Delhi:
The organization needs to establish training standards that all employees must follow.
The organization needs to use permanent staff members for all its operational activities.
The organization needs to maintain its internal order system while enforcing responsibility measures against its members.
The organization needs to conduct its business operations through transparent processes that match all governmental regulations.
The license protects clients while it builds trust and reliability for security agencies that work in Delhi.
PSARA licenses get classified into specific categories that depend on the regions where agencies function.
Single‑State PSARA License
The security agency needs this license to conduct operations restricted to Delhi. The majority of startups and small-to-medium agencies choose this category to apply for their PSARA license in Delhi.
Multi‑State PSARA License

The multi-state PSARA license becomes necessary when a business wants to operate in Delhi and multiple other states. The company needs to obtain separate approvals for each state while maintaining its existing business structure.
